options.label: Build cache (dangling)
options.description: Runs `docker builder prune -f`. Uses your account if you are in the docker group, otherwise the system helper.

options.label: All build cache
options.description: Runs `docker builder prune -f --all`; the next builds start without cache.

options.label: Stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images
options.description: Runs `docker system prune -f`. Stopped containers are removed with their writable layer.

options.label: All images not used by a container
options.description: Runs `docker image prune -a -f`. Images are pulled or rebuilt again when needed.

options.label: Unused anonymous volumes
options.description: Runs `docker volume prune -f` (Engine 23+: anonymous volumes only). Volumes may hold databases.
options.extra_confirmation: I understand unused volumes may contain database data that will be lost

options.label: All unused volumes, including named ones
options.description: Runs `docker volume prune -a -f`. Named volumes of stopped projects (databases!) are deleted permanently.
options.extra_confirmation: I understand ALL unused named volumes and their data will be deleted
